scientific_integrity: The finite proof is regenerated from an explicit graph definition and a complete acyclic matching on 1696 nonempty simplices; homology traces are computed using all simplicial faces and the sixteen symmetry maps. The delivered verification code was executed successfully. No claim of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: A complete finite homotopy and integral dihedral-character determination for the eight-vertex Wagner graph only; no general Möbius-ladder formula or integral quotient classification. The nearest recent paper on Möbius-ladder independence and perfect matching was accessible only through its abstract. A currently unindexed equivalent result cannot be excluded.
title: A dihedral five-sphere in the two-matching complex of the Wagner graph
